Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s instructions to open authoritative sources and extract the death year. Instead, it remained on search results pages and repeatedly ran similar queries without clicking into credible pages (e.g., Wikipedia, museum entries, Treccani/RKD) or executing the direct query for “Lorenzo Costa the Younger death year.” This led to a loop with no progress and prevented obtaining the correct death year (1583), resulting in an incorrect/absent solution.
